sub: Once for every account. The token lives in the cc-slaves Keychain; lanes never see it.
step.consent: Waiting for you to approve in the browser
step.waiting: Waiting for the browser — login page opened
err.no_metadata: The server's login details were not found
fix.no_metadata: The server may not use OAuth — check the URL. Nothing was saved.
err.no_s256: The server does not support PKCE S256 — stopped for safety
fix.no_s256: No token saved: without S256 someone else could use the login link.
err.client_registration: The server refuses automatic registration — enter a Client ID
fix.client_registration: Create an OAuth app in the server's admin page with the redirect below, then paste its Client ID.
fix.denied: Nothing was saved. Retry to open the login page again.
err.issuer_mismatch: The server returned another issuer — stopped for safety
fix.issuer_mismatch: The issuer does not match the server found. No token saved.
fix.timeout: The browser never came back to cc-slaves. Retry to start again.
err.network: Network error — check the connection / VPN
fix.network: The login server could not be reached. The old token (if any) is kept.
fix.user: Edit the server's URL if it is wrong.
fix.source: The server comes from {source}: open the source file to see the URL, tell the provider if the URL is right.
detail.issuerNone: Expected {expected}; the server sent no issuer.
keychainNote: Stored in the cc-slaves Keychain (this server's cc-slaves-mcp item), never in ~/.claude.json or a plugin file.
